title: Paystride Fees Credited With a Signed Claim, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans, the Paystride fees credited with a signed lost or stolen card claim follow the claimed transaction.

**When Paystride fees were charged on the claimed transaction.** These are an out-of-network ATM fee, an international ATM fee or a foreign transaction fee. They count less any part of them already returned by refund or correction.

**When the claimed transaction is a domestic out-of-network ATM withdrawal that carried no out-of-network ATM fee, because it was one of its pay period's free withdrawals.** The plan's out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee counts for the free withdrawal it used: 1.75 on the Premier plan and 1.50 on the Elite plan.

**Otherwise** nothing counts.

For a claim whose provisional credit the signed claim schedule for the Premier and Elite plans priced, and only for such a claim, the fees credited with the signed claim credit are not returned again when an error is found. A fee credited within a signed claim credit that the signed claim schedule for the Premier and Elite plans prices, and only such a fee, is not corrected again. The other lost or stolen card claim schedules of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account state their own.

## Hypothetical cases

| Claimed transaction | Fees on it | Already returned | Fees credited |
|---|---|---|---|
| domestic out-of-network withdrawal beyond the free allowance, Premier | out-of-network fee 1.75 | none | 1.75 |
| ATM withdrawal outside the United States in a foreign currency, Elite | international ATM 2.00 and foreign transaction 1.87 | the 2.00 fee, by refund | 1.87 |
| domestic out-of-network withdrawal, one of the free withdrawals, Elite | none | none | 1.50 |
| purchase in US dollars at a domestic merchant | none | none | nothing |
